Where does a “confirm before delete” rule belong?
system

Before deleting a project, explain the scope and ask the user to confirm.

user

Delete all old projects.

→
App permission checkWaiting for an action
How rules guide responses without replacing permissions

Rules enter with requests or in configuration files: Passed as a 'system' role message in API calls or stored in .cursorrules/project settings. It guides the model to explain risks, seek confirmation, or follow formatting constraints.

The model only recommends without privileged access: The model follows these rules to generate outputs but has no autonomous privileges in external systems.

Critical actions still require product code enforcement: Before deleting, paying, or mutating records, backend code must verify permissions—prompts alone are not a security barrier.

What people often confuse

A system prompt is not permanent memory or a security guarantee. Code must enforce permissions and business rules.
